experiment: E117 neuron_vpd_count: the switched-on set and re-switching on MLP neurons at VPD's count, 67M
kind: a comparison of two methods on states whose class is known by construction; no reuse verdict, decisions.md rows 81 and 87 untouched

settings.s_on_thr_source: E12's switched-on threshold (new_vs_existing predictions_amend2.json config s_on_thr; recruit.switched on recruit.trigger_dg, alive subcomponents only, frozen released Gamma)
settings.random_seeds: 0..19, the same seeds on every state
settings.batch_source: kv: E12/E46's route_cells batch (local_faith default 64); pile: E53's CFG.batch 32 (performed_anchor run.py). Every forward of a family, both methods, uses that family's batch

random_update.rule: finetune.random_direction: a Gaussian per matrix scaled to that matrix's Frobenius norm in ident32_s0

states.order_note: the random-map states first: they carry all three apparatus controls (the S_on counts), so a broken apparatus stops the job on the first state
states.files: E12/E46 copy and random maps: experiments/regating_table/results/large/{task}_s{seed}.pt (fp32 delta-W, scored step), windows_{task}.pt['heldout'] (97 windows, read at the trigger). E53: experiments/performed_anchor/results/large/dW_{task}_s{seed}_step300.pt (bf16, read .float()), 500 scored windows (regating_truth_table run.py e53_tasks), read at position 63 with the true next token as target. sha256 of each checked against the source run's record before the model loads (neuron_r run.py files)

panels.K_VPD: |S_on|: alive subcomponents whose mean (over windows) causal-importance change at the read position, state minus W0, is above s_on_thr
panels.N_on: the K_VPD neurons (GELU outputs, 4 x 3072, flat index block x 3072 + i) with the largest mean (over windows) firing change at the read position, state minus W0; sorted descending, stable (ties: lower flat index first); taken whatever the sign once the positive changes run out

A.vpd: Jaccard of S_on between seed 0 and seed 1 of a task (recruit.jaccard)
A.neurons: Jaccard of N_on between the seeds, each seed's N_on taken at K_A = floor((K_VPD(s0) + K_VPD(s1)) / 2 + 0.5)

B.vpd: rho_S = (T1 - R_S) / (T1 - T0): R_S the fine-tuned model's mean log-odds with S_on's outputs at the read position put back to W0's (recruitment.restore_hooks, W0's cached input through each released subcomponent, E50's restore); T plain full-model log-odds under bf16 autocast (finetune.logits_of)
B.neurons: rho_N = (T1 - R_N) / (T1 - T0): R_N the fine-tuned model's mean log-odds with N_on's firing at the read position put back to W0's own firing a0 (cached from W0's forward on the same window: W0's weights on W0's input, the procedure of E50's VPD restore, which puts back W0's cached input); every other neuron and position live; fp32, TF32 off. Lead's decision 2026-11-06, before any run
B.neurons_reported_beside: rho_N_ah (cells.json B.neurons_ah): the same with N_on's firing at the read position set to Ah, W0's c_fc and GELU on the fine-tuned model's MLP input (the plan's parenthetical; neuron_r.half_acts, cached from the state's own forward). Reported only, set and whole set, no random draws

C.vpd: r_S = (L(C0, G_S) - L00) / (T1 - T0): G_S W0's gates everywhere except S_on, which takes the state's gates at every position (recruit.hybrid); L the masked forward of the released components, Delta out (local_faith.masked_lo_windows, C0's masked forward); T from Gamma's pass (route_cells' units)
C.neurons: r_N = (L_N - T0) / (T1 - T0): L_N W0's model with N_on's firing replaced by the state's firing A1 at every block and every position (A1 cached from the state's forward), every other neuron live; fp32. With every neuron in N_on it is E98's r_n cell L(O0, A1) - T0 exactly

panels.random_floor: B and C: 20 random sets per state, recruit.random_like (VPD: as many alive subcomponents per matrix as S_on has, outside S_on; neurons: as many per block as N_on has, outside N_on), reported as mean, min and max of the share
panels.limits_reported: B and C at the whole set (VPD: every alive subcomponent; neurons: all 12288), both sides; C's limits are the controls below; B's VPD limit is E53's relay rho on lowercase and cipher (0.657, 0.655 / 0.418, 0.414, performed_anchor read.json, reported beside, no stop)
panels.reference_strip: full-width re-switching, not rerun: VPD r (regating_truth_table/results/table.json), neuron r_half and r_n (neuron_r/results/cells.json)

w0_control.rule: every task read with delta-W = 0 before any state: max |g1 - g0| over windows, positions, subcomponents (dead included) == 0 and max |firing change| == 0 exactly; every per-window log-odds difference (T1 - T0 both units, every limit's numerator) <= 1e-5 in absolute value
w0_control.expected: all 0; K_VPD = 0, so every panel reads unreadable at W0

r_all_alive.rule: |r at every alive subcomponent (G_S with S = all alive) - reference r| <= 0.005, on every state with a reference
r_all_alive.reported_beside: r_every: the same with every subcomponent, dead ones too (equal to the route split's L01 by construction): tells a miss from the dead set apart from a miss of the apparatus

r_n_all_neurons.rule: |r_N with every neuron - E98's r_n| <= 0.01, on every state

apparatus_controls.order: W0 control on every task first, then per state (random maps first) the three controls are checked the moment the state is read, before the next state

separation_rule.source: E12, experiments/new_vs_existing/results/predictions.json separation_rule, quoted: "a number separates the classes when the two classes' ranges (one value per fine-tuned state: 4 per class; for the across-seed numbers one per task: 2 per class) do not overlap AND the gap between the ranges exceeds the larger within-class range; the predicted direction must hold"
separation_rule.as_applied: existing class E, new class N, one value per state (A: per task). gap = min(E) - max(N); within = max(max(E) - min(E), max(N) - min(N)); 'separates' iff gap > within (strict; gap > within >= 0 implies the ranges do not overlap and the direction holds); otherwise 'does not separate', with direction 'reversed' recorded when min(N) - max(E) > within
separation_rule.direction: existing higher on A, B and C
separation_rule.comparisons_note: the plan's 'two per class on lowercase/cipher' is read as two comparisons, lowercase against each E53 cipher, two states per class each
unreadable: a state's value is unreadable when its K_VPD = 0 (both methods: the sets are empty) or, on B and C, when its |T1 - T0| in that side's units is under gain_floor
a task's A value is unreadable when either seed has K_VPD = 0 (both methods)
a panel is unreadable when a class has fewer than 2 readable values; so A on the lowercase comparisons (one task per class) is always unreadable, its Jaccards reported
the random_update row and the W0 rows are in no class

edge_cases_checked.K_VPD = 0: value unreadable (not 0); a class short of 2 makes the panel unreadable
edge_cases_checked.ties: equal values: gap = 0 is not > within (>= 0): does not separate. gap == within: does not separate (strict)
edge_cases_checked.two per class: within is one range per class; the rule reads as written
edge_cases_checked.one per class: unreadable (within would be 0 and any difference would pass)

e53_bar.source: E53's lowercase-against-cipher bar (reports/plans/2026-11-06_plan_e117-neurons-at-vpd-count.md, 'Filed rule'; regating_truth_table stage1 order)
e53_bar.rule: min over lowercase_s0, lowercase_s1 minus max over e53_cipher_s0, e53_cipher_s1, broad_cipher_s0, broad_cipher_s1 >= 0.3, both ciphers pooled as E53 pooled them
e53_bar.shown: beside the separation rule, both methods; 'unreadable' when any of the six values is unreadable

guesses.note: guesses, no pass or fail for the project

neurons_A_B_C_every_comparison.why: a coin flip; E98 and E52 lean the wrong way on copy against random maps

guesses.not_guessed: VPD's C on every comparison and VPD's A and B on the lowercase comparisons: the plan files no guess; reported as read

blind_to.A: only whether the set repeats across batch orders, not what the set does
blind_to.C: the VPD side keeps C0's masks, so it misses delta-W outside the components (E46's e_delta); the neuron side holds attention at W0's

noise_floor: the spread between seeds, and the random-set range
positive_controls: the C limits (r at every alive subcomponent, r_N at every neuron) reproducing E46/E53's r and E98's r_n

expected_at_reference_rows.W0: all numerators 0, K_VPD 0, every panel unreadable
expected_at_reference_rows.random_update: reported only, in no class: expected few or no subcomponents switched on (K_VPD near 0) and a gain under the floor, so unreadable
